top_signals.title: Solar Has Overtaken Nuclear in the Global Power Mix
top_signals.summary: Last year, solar power quietly overtook nuclear power in the global energy mix. This is a stunning feat when you consider that just a decade ago, in 2015, global solar generation amounted to just 256 terawatt-hours (TWh)  in 2015, while global nuclear power generated ten-fold that amount at 2,576 TWh. And solar didn’t just overtake nuclear power in 2025; it surpassed it by a wide margin, producing 13 percent more energy worldwide.  "[Solar] generating more electricity than all the world's nuclear power plants is a pretty insane…
